captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a mountain bike crankset. It features a central bottom bracket spindle with a double chainring assembly and a four-arm spider, all finished in dark grey and black. Extending from either side are two silver-grey alloy crank arms oriented 180 degrees apart. At the end of each crank arm, a black clipless pedal with silver retention bars is mounted on a thin axle. The entire crank assembly revolves around the bottom bracket axis, and each pedal rotates independently on its axle.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a mountain bike crankset. The model should include a central bottom bracket, a double chainring with a 4-arm spider, two 180-degree offset alloy crank arms in a metallic silver finish, and two black clipless pedals. Implement revolute joints for the crank rotation and independent continuous rotation for each pedal on its axle.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first defining a fixed bottom bracket spindle using a cylinder primitive. The rotating crank assembly is modeled as a single part containing the double chainrings (created via patterned tooth cuts on cylindrical disks), the 4-arm spider, and both crank arms (lofted or extruded profiles), connected to the spindle via a continuous joint. Two pedal parts are constructed from box primitives (for the body and retention clips) and cylinder primitives (for the axles), each attached to its respective crank arm tip using a continuous joint to allow rotation.
